title: Credit Controller
description:
REED Accountancy and Finance are working in partnership with a leading Poole Based Manufacturing and Warehouse Firm recruiting a Permanent Credit Controller to join a busy and dynamic Finance Team.

CREDIT CONTROL POSITION
- Contract type: Permanent
- Salary - up to £30,000 per annum
- Hours: 40 hours per week
- Monday-Friday 8am-5pm

Details

Effectively manage and control debts. Responsible for collecting invoices and ensure that credit given to customers is monitored whilst providing excellent customer service.

What you will be doing

Act as a main point of contact for customer account queries
- Reconciliation, managing customer portals and integration (EDI)
- Review new and existing accounts for creditworthiness, setting or suggesting appropriate terms and credit limits, considering previous history, credit agency and trade references and other relevant sources of information
- Effectively review, manage and collect customer accounts, prioritising to maximise cash flow whist minimising risk exposure (bad debts)
- Resolve invoice and payment queries promptly and efficiently
- Produce and distribute customer statements of account.
- Produce and distribute customer overdue/reminder letters
- Produce and circulate weekly and ad hoc on stop, credit hold status and other reports.
- Proactive management of new accounts and high value invoices
- Build effective relationships with customers and internal contacts.
- Prepare month end consolidated invoices.
- Escalate significant issues/concerns as necessary

Trips

- Ensure trip costs are correctly allocated and fully accounted for, and that cash or Caxton cards are available as needed.

title: Payroll Officer
description:
Sheridan Maine is partnering with a well-established, multi-site organisation in Poole to recruit an experienced Payroll Officer to take responsibility for end-to-end payroll operations. This is an excellent opportunity for a payroll professional with strong knowledge of UK payroll legislation, HMRC compliance, and statutory payments to join a stable and growing business.

If you have proven experience running weekly and monthly payroll across salaried and hourly employees, I would like to hear from you.

Payroll Officer - Key Responsibilities
As Payroll Officer, you will take full ownership of the payroll function, ensuring accurate and compliant payroll processing across multiple sites.
- Manage end-to-end payroll for weekly and monthly payroll cycles
- Process payroll for salaried and hourly employees, including overtime and variable pay
- Administer new starters, leavers, salary changes, and payroll adjustments
- Maintain accurate payroll records including tax codes, deductions, and pension contributions
- Ensure full compliance with UK payroll legislation and HMRC requirements
- Submit FPS and EPS reports and manage year-end processes including P60s and P45s
- Process statutory payments including SSP and SMP
- Prepare payroll journals and support finance with reconciliations and year-end reporting
- Submit P11 D and P11 D(b) returns
- Respond to employee payroll queries in a timely and professional manner
- Support payroll system upgrades, data validation, and continuous process improvement
- Work collaboratively with HR and Finance to ensure payroll accuracy
Payroll Officer - Skills & Experience Required
- Proven experience in end-to-end payroll processing
- Strong knowledge of UK payroll compliance and HMRC submissions
- Experience processing statutory payments and pensions
- Advanced Excel skills
- High attention to detail and strong numerical accuracy
- Ability to work independently and manage multiple deadlines

This Payroll position is ideal for candidates seeking payroll jobs, payroll administrator jobs, or payroll officer roles where they can utilise their end-to-end payroll expertise.
Apply today for a confidential discussion about this Payroll Officer opportunity.
